about: Unofficial fan guide. Grand Theft Auto VI launched 19 November 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S (Rockstar Games, announced 6 November 2025; also reported by Gamer Guides and FinalBoss). The trophy names, descriptions and grades below are the list as reported by Exophase and PSNProfiles, who agree on all 55, and by GamesRadar+, Press Start and PC Gamer on 18 November 2026. Rockstar and Sony had not published the list on their own store pages at that check. Every guide below is written in my own words; a specific step or count with no source earns no credit, so each guide names its source. Anything I could not verify from two independent sources is tagged [unverified].
sources: Exophase + PSNProfiles — the 55 trophy names, descriptions and grades (both agree on all 55)
GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer — the same 55-trophy list, reported 18 November 2026
GTABase + PowerPyx — Positive Mental Attitude is the only possibly missable trophy; no mission replay; cheats disable trophies and saving
Rockstar Games Trailer 2 (6 May 2025) + rockstargames.com/VI — Leonida, Vice City, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos
Output Lag + GTAScoop — platinum estimate around 200 hours [unverified]; no mission replay; manual save per chapter advised
cryptogames.gg — 55 trophies, 27 visible / 28 hidden, all single-player, no online trophies
title: Leonida Legend — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order (story, then stranger strands, then activities, then collectibles, then 100% cleanup) and this is the last trophy you earn. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list, 18 Nov 2026).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it pops at the mission's end. Play through the intro as the game teaches it — no side goal is needed. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GTAScoop (story trophies unlock automatically and cannot be missed).
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the Lucia balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — that one spot is reported missable after the chapter ends. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GTABase + PowerPyx (the one missable trophy).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish Chapter 2 and it pops at the chapter's end. By this point both Jason and Lucia are playable, which is when most of the open-world list opens up, so start folding activities and collectibles into your route from here. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); Output Lag (both protagonists playable from Chapter 2).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish Chapter 3 and it pops when the chapter closes. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — the game is reported to have no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your only way back if you miss something optional inside it. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GTABase + PowerPyx (no mission replay).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish Chapter 4 and it pops at the chapter's end. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so before you push into the final mission, sweep any chapter-locked optional content you still owe (meditation spots, stranger strands). Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); Output Lag (save before the final mission).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Gold, unmissable: finish the final mission and it pops. Make a manual save before you start it — with no mission replay reported, that save is the only way to replay the finale or to try a different choice afterwards. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); Output Lag (no mission replay, save before the final mission).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission Breakfast Run and it pops at the mission's end. Story-mission trophies like this one cannot be missed — they unlock by playing the mission through. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GTAScoop (story trophies unlock automatically).
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission The Cartel Heist and it pops. Heist missions are story beats, so just play the mission to its end — no extra objective is attached to the trophy itself. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GTAScoop (story trophies unlock automatically).
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission Child's Play and it pops. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is awarded for completing the mission, not for any hidden condition inside it. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GTAScoop (story trophies unlock automatically).
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission Headliners and it pops. The name suggests a showpiece mission, but the trophy itself only asks for completion — play it through and move on. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GTAScoop (story trophies unlock automatically).
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport and it pops. It also introduces the airport as a location, which matters later for Catch Me If You Can. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GTAScoop (story trophies unlock automatically).
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission Operation Savage Glory and it pops. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies, so by the time it pops you should already be deep into the open-world cleanup. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GTAScoop (story trophies unlock automatically).
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Gold and the real grind: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. That checklist is reported to cover story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the counted feats below — so treat every other trophy as a step toward this one, and leave it for last. The platinum is estimated at around 200 hours, mostly because of this trophy [unverified — Output Lag + GTAScoop agree on the estimate, but no two sources confirm the exact checklist contents]. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); Output Lag + GTAScoop (~200-hour estimate).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Silver: pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count toward the running total, and the game tracks it cumulatively, so every stunt you do while travelling counts. Chain stunts into your normal driving instead of grinding them in one sitting. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of every activity type — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and the rest — and it pops once the last type is sampled. The list counts 9 types in the starter's reading of the trophy data, but the exact activity roster is [unverified] until a second source confirms it, so sample everything the map offers. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); starter count of 9 types [unverified].
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver and one of the hardest skill trophies: earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practice one weapon class at a time, learn each challenge's target pattern before chasing gold, and do the range early — the aim skills carry into every combat trophy. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 42 challenges); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates before racing for the win — a clean line beats raw speed — and tick locations off one at a time rather than hopping between them. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 14 locations); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix road races, off-road and water events as you find them, and use the best vehicle class for each event rather than your favourite car for all of them. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal Hampton in a fishing challenge. Cal is one of the eight named characters Rockstar introduced with Trailer 2, so expect this to come through his strand of activities — take the challenge when it is offered and fish patiently rather than reeling hard. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); Rockstar Trailer 2 (Cal Hampton is a named character).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Arcades are scattered around Leonida — pick the game that suits you, learn its loop in a practice run, then play a full run to completion. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Stranger-style mission strands build up over several meetings — keep answering Andy's calls and visiting his marker whenever it appears, and the strand closes with this trophy. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); cryptogames.gg (stranger strands are part of the 100% path).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. As with the other stranger finals, the strand only advances when you show up for each of Kenton's missions in turn — don't leave a strand half-finished while you chase collectibles. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); cryptogames.gg (stranger strands).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy's strand closes the same way as Andy's and Kenton's: play each of his missions as they appear until the final one pops this trophy. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); cryptogames.gg (stranger strands).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver: complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) are six of them — find two more stranger markers on the map and play each strand to its final mission. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 8 strands); cryptogames.gg (stranger strands).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy is one of the stranger-strand givers — follow his missions in order until the strand's final mission pops this trophy. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); cryptogames.gg (stranger strands).
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's strand works like the others: each mission unlocks the next, so return to his marker whenever it lights up instead of letting the strand sit. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); cryptogames.gg (stranger strands).
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only trophy two sources flag as possibly missable. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, and do the Lucia balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before that chapter ends: it is reported to disappear after Chapter 1, and with no mission replay there is no way back except a chapter-start save. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. Source: GTABase + PowerPyx (only possibly missable trophy); Output Lag (Chapter 1 balcony spot, no mission replay).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. This is a stranger-strand final, so work through Bret's missions until the hunt is offered, then track the animal patiently — it is a single named target, not a general hunting quota. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); cryptogames.gg (stranger strands).
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Silver: complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect them as you explore rather than hunting them all at once, and keep a checklist of which sets are one card short so you can finish them in a single sweep. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 3 sets); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: Silver: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. This is a pure coverage grind — visit new districts as the story takes you there and WAiNK at every spot you pass, so the count builds up without a dedicated farming run. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 100 locations); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives layered over normal play — stunts, combat feats, driving goals — so they accumulate while you work on other trophies; check the challenge list regularly and steer toward the ones nearly done. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 50 challenges); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and escape until the heat dies down. Use the countryside or water to break pursuit, and don't let your partner get caught while you run — both of you need to get clear. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the trick is keeping the wanted level alive between robberies, so move fast between shops and don't let the heat drop to zero or spike out of control. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new car, bike, boat or aircraft you sit in counts — so drive everything you see instead of sticking to one favourite, and sweep car parks, docks and airfields for models you haven't found. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 100 vehicles); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a clustered group, trigger Combat Focus when they bunch up, and keep firing until the fifth drops — if the focus ends early, the count resets, so don't waste it on two or three stragglers. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — grab a plane and take off without following the airport's script. The trophy's joke is the method: don't wait for permission, just fly out. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhino tanks, and the exact trigger is not spelled out by the official list — so this one is [unverified]: expect it to involve stealing, driving or surviving in a Rhino tank, and try each of those in turn. Don't trust any single walkthrough's guess until players confirm it after launch. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official description only); no second source confirms the trigger [unverified].
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take what you need and leave before any alarm — a loud approach fails the trophy even if the robbery succeeds. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: Silver: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car parked close, a route out of the city — because the escape is part of the trophy, not just the robbery. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 5 vaults); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes around Leonida — intercept one, crack it open, then lose the heat before the trophy counts it. A getaway vehicle waiting nearby turns a hard escape into a formality. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The state covers Vice City plus the Keys, wetlands, farmland and coast (Rockstar Trailer 2 named six regions), so this is a map-coverage trophy: visit every named area, and use the in-game map to spot the blank patches you haven't touched. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 52 areas); Rockstar Trailer 2 (six regions of Leonida).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Learn which operation belongs to which gang before you hit it — robbing two operations of the same gang doesn't advance the count. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 9 gangs); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. Ocean Beach is the beachfront strip of Vice City — find a bar there, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view; the trophy is a quiet moment, not a challenge. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); Rockstar Trailer 2 (Vice City setting).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic GTA style — drive straight through the glass and out onto the street. The trophy's joke is the method: don't use the door, use the window. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end of the game. Bowling is one of the activity types for Master of None, so this trophy and that one can be worked together. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: The official description gives no concrete step — just a partnership with mass appeal — so the exact trigger is [unverified]. The likeliest reading is a co-op moment with your partner that draws a crowd, so watch for it while doing partner activities and don't trust any single guess until players confirm it. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official description only); no second source confirms the trigger [unverified].
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. The PSN-tracked count for this trophy is 500 actions — every choice that moves your criminal profile counts, so it builds up across the whole game and is best left to accumulate while you do everything else. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); u7buy / GTAScoop (500 Criminal Profile actions).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description hints at succeeding on a second try, but the official list names no activity — so the exact trigger is [unverified]. The likeliest reading is retrying something you failed once and passing it the second time; keep playing normally and it should come to you, and don't trust any single walkthrough's guess yet. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official description only); no second source confirms the trigger [unverified].
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description suggests witnessing something strange, but the official list names no event — so the exact trigger is [unverified]. The likeliest reading is a rare random event or easter egg somewhere in Leonida; explore widely and it should find you, and don't trust any single location claim until players confirm it. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official description only); no second source confirms the trigger [unverified].
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Line the target up from the passenger side, time the swing as you pass, and don't slow down: the drive-by part is what the trophy counts. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — feed them through your laundering contacts steadily instead of hoarding them, and the total adds up across the game. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, $250,000); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Normal spending on weapons, clothes, cars and supplies counts toward it — don't force it early, just buy what your run needs and it will pop during the cleanup phase. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, $100,000); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are properties you purchase, so save up and buy them as you find them — they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles Whip It Good and On the Spot ask you to collect. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 8 garages); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — ten different vehicles, so use the variety you already discovered for Whip It Good. Source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list, 10 vehicles); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer (same list).
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer
